citations.locator: The one-visible-device local maca broker job maca-feef2fc7be92 evaluated standalone tl.fma on 644 FP32 triples: 128 repetitions of an FMA-versus-separate-rounding discriminator, 512 deterministic finite normal triples and four subnormal boundary triples. The Compiler-generated Cake source at 28982965 ran in separate broker job maca-f697166c27ba on the complete [8,128] output: the 128 distinguishing, 892 normal and four subnormal results matched the independent exact-rational round-to-nearest-even oracle bitwise; all input bits were unchanged. C550-2 Triton 3.6 and captured C550-1 FlagTree/Triton 3.1 each compiled that projected source to native xcore1000 mcfatbin with math.fma retained in TTIR/TTGIR; the 3.1 route did not run the numeric probe. Raw observations and compiler artifacts: open-cake-ir-evidence/metax-fma-probe-20260926/. This is bounded FP32 instruction evidence, not a formal Workload Evaluation, exceptional-value proof, timing or performance qualification.

Job maca-f2c4ba1f66a2 executed the original MoE four-stage routing composition at its fixed shapes and all six original cases: 24 native calls, 48 expert IDs exact, 48 FP32 weights within predeclared atol=rtol=2e-6 (maximum absolute error 5.960464477539063e-08). All external and 54 per-stage input tensors retained their bytes. This exercises integer program/range coordinates, integer equality, FP32 selection with negative-infinity masking and resident FP32 top-k at widths32/8/256 and k2/4/8. Integer-score and loop-carried top-k remain unqualified; no expert GEMM, full MoE, arbitrary-shape or performance qualification. Raw observations: open-cake-ir-evidence/metax-parity-20260920/moe-routing-gpu-49f707f5-v1/; independent review: reviews/moe-routing-device-49f707f5.md.

E4M3FN storage and decoding only. Native loader job maca-bd7ef50c9f98 copied all 256 encodings under two output poisons with all 512 output bytes exact, including signed zero and both NaN codes; input bytes unchanged. Job maca-584187da1812 decoded all 254 finite encodings bit-exact to FP16 and FP32 and classified both NaN codes for each destination. Raw data and independent reviews: open-cake-ir-evidence/metax-parity-20260920/fp8-copy-gpu-6d997c3d-v1/, fp8-diagnostic-gpu-6d997c3d-v1/ and reviews/. Scalar FP8 conversion hits a captured SDK RankedTensorType assertion and remains refused; inverse conversion, FP8-to-BF16, direct FP8 arithmetic and MMA are not admitted by these observations.

Standalone native-loader matrix diagnostic, 64x64x64 and four execution groups: FP16, BF16 and FP32 IEEE tl.dot each passed five finite input distributions with unchanged input bits and complete 4096-element outputs per case against a presealed CPU float64 dot rounded to FP32 (atol 0.001, rtol 0.0001). Maximum absolute errors were 6.103515625e-05, 6.103515625e-05 and 0.000152587890625, respectively. This is bounded instruction/ABI evidence, not all shapes, looped accumulation, timing or registered-task qualification. Raw arrays/specs and independent scalar-reference review: open-cake-ir-evidence/metax-parity-20260920/matrix-numerics-gpu-66dcc472-v1/ and matrix-numerics-prepared-66dcc472-v1/. TF32 failed its separate RNE10 hypothesis and remains unadmitted; direct FP8 dot failed LLVM lowering. Neither mode is substituted for IEEE.

This is bounded diagnostic evidence, not a global error proof or a Workload receipt.
